body: I can be written, I can be spoken, I can be exposed, I can be broken?
I can bring back the dead and a tear to your eye. A stir of emotions will follow close by. What am I?
I can burn your mouth and sting your eye but I am consumed everyday. What am I?
I can fall off a building and live but in water I will die. What am I?
I can feel any space, float and disappear. Never touching the ground I help others get around. What am I?
I can fill a house or fill your mouth but you can never catch me in your hands. What am I?
I can fill a room but I take up no space. What am I?
I can fill a room but take up no space. Look out at night and I am in no place. What am I?
I can fly but I have no wings. I can cry but I have no eyes. Wherever I go, darkness follows me. What am I?
I can generate fear and some say I come out of your ears. I am as quite as a mouse but not welcomed in the house. What am I?
I can go through glass without breaking it. What am I?
I can help you to mend. I hide my body but never my head. What am I?
I can honk without using a horn?
I can honk without using a horn. What am I?
I can invent dreams or open the skies. It's easy to use me, just close your eyes. What am I?
I can never be stolen from you. I am owned by everyone. Some have more, some have less. What am I?
I can only be played on a windy day. What am I?
I can run but not walk, have a mouth but cant talk and a bed but I do not sleep. What am I?
I can run but not walk. Wherever I go, thought follows close behind?
I can run but not walk. Wherever I go, thought follows close behind. What am I?
I can shave everyday but my beard will stay. who am I?
I can sing but I can't talk. I can climb a high tree but can't run. I have very soft hair and a very hard mouth?
I can sizzle like bacon, I am made with an egg. I have plenty of backbone but lack a good leg. I peel layers like onions but still remain whole. I can be long, like a flagpole, yet fit in a hole?

I can sizzle like bacon. I am made with an egg, I have plenty of backbone but lack a good leg. I peel layers like onions but still remain whole. I can be long, like a flagpole, yet fit in a hole. What am I?
I can speak with my hard metal tongue. But I cannot breathe, for I have no lung. What am I?
I can swim but never get wet. I can run but never get tired. I follow you everywhere but never say a word. What am I?
I can trap many different things and colors, Ever changing, not boring. Look closely and you may find yourself Also caught in my trap?
I can travel from there to here by disappearing and here to there by reappearing?
I can travel the world without leaving my corner. What am I?
I can wake you up in the morning but I require no electricity or winding. What am I?
I can wave my hands at you but I never say goodbye. You are always cool when with me, even more so when I am high! What am I?
I can't believe it's not?
I can't go left, I can't go right. I am forever stuck in a building over three stories high. What am I?
I cannot be bought, cannot be sold, even if I'm sometimes made of gold. What am I?
I cannot be burned in fire or drowned in water. What am I?
I cannot be felt or moved but as you come closer, I get more distant. What am I?
I cannot be felt, seen or touched. Yet I can be found in everybody. My existence is always in debate. Yet I have my own style of music?
I cannot be felt, seen or touched. Yet I can be found in everybody. My existence is always in debate. Yet I have my own style of music. What am I?
I cannot be other than what I am, Until the man who made me dies, Power and glory will fall to me finally, Only when he last closes his eyes?
I cannot be other than what I am, until the man who made me dies. Power and glory will fall to me finally. Only when he last closes his eyes?
I cannot be used until I have been broken. What am I?
I cannot hear or even see but sense light and sounds there may be, sometimes I end up on a hook, I can be combined with a book?
I cannot walk and cannot see, I'm straw on a stick but keep things tidy. What am I?
I carried by mad animals. What am I?
I carry my home on my back. I am not rich but I leave silver in my track. What am I?
I carry you down a gental stream. What am I?
I cause involuntary movements in your vehicle. What am I?
I climb higher as I get hotter. I can never escape from my crystal cage. What am I?
I come down but never go up. What am I?
I come in different colors and shapes. Some parts of me are curvy, some are straight. You can put me anywhere you like but there is only one right place for me. What am I?
